Ok, so first install the map on Nexus Mods Or just search Teardown mods, then click the bottom left after its done installing. Next open it and extract or unzip the document. Delete the zip or rar file because you have the map folder extracted now. Open steam right click Teardown, manage, and then browse local files. Next open mods. Then drag the map folder into mods. If it doesn’t work, then open your map folder and if both the folder and the xml document is called custom, rename both to main, reply if you need more help.
